documents.text: John Harman (British politician) Sir John Andrew Harman (born 30 July 1950, Castleford) is a former Chairman of the Environment Agency. He attended the independent St George's College, Weybridge. From the University of Manchester he gained a BSc degree in Maths, then did a PGCE at Huddersfield College of Education. He was a maths teacher at Greenhead College in Huddersfield from 1973-9. He was Head of Maths at Barnsley Sixth Form College from 1979-90, then Senior Maths Lecturer at Barnsley College (it took over the sixth form college) from 1990-7.
